overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: any person may record an open session, but the chair could bar a member from using the cable access equipment because the Board had voted not to use it.

allegations.summary: Complainant, a board member, alleges the Board improperly barred him from video-recording the November 16, 2011 meeting using the cable public access equipment.
allegations.key_passage: In this instance, it was permissible for the chair to reject Mr. McLintock's request because she did not prohibit him from recording, only from using equipment owned by the cable company.
